text: PR reviews posted via 'gh pr review' appear under the shared PAT identity thorsten-a-maier_accent (state COMMENTED); agent attribution comes only from the gh-as-agent stamp marker, not the GitHub author.

Repo isolation: default = shared pool volume + per-agent SubPath mounts (orchestrator writes to /workspace/agents/<id>/ are directly visible to the container). Opt-in AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME=1 gives each agent a dedicated authoritative volume; seedPerAgentVolume only copies into an EMPTY dst, updates need explicit reseedPerAgentVolume (only for a running agent). Seeding/migration changes to CLAUDE.md/AGENT-PROMPT.md/skills must handle BOTH modes.
